subject.value: Airborne Auxiliary Power – Auxiliary Power Unit Fuel Control Unit – Replacement
subject.raw_text: ATA 49 – Airborne Auxiliary Power – Auxiliary Power Unit Fuel Control Unit – Replacement

foreign_ad.raw_text: Foreign AD: None or Not applicable

applicability_groups.label: A330/A340 applicability stated in the AD

definitions.definition_text: APU fuel control unit P/N 3883240-3, -5 or -6 with a serial number listed in the SB, or one with an epoxy-type housing repair identified by code P30148, P30149, P30150 or P31178.
An eligible APU fuel control unit that is not affected; a unit re-identified with SB number 331-49-7954 is serviceable.
Group 1 aeroplanes have an affected part installed; Group 2 aeroplanes do not.

unsafe_condition.raw_reason_text: Reason: An occurrence has been reported where cracks were found in the fuel control unit housing assembly of a Honeywell GTCP331-350 APU, which caused fuel leakage in the APU compartment. This condition, if not corrected, could lead to an uncommanded APU in-flight shutdown, or fire in the APU compartment, possibly resulting in damage to the aeroplane . To address this potential unsafe condition, Honeywell issued the SB, as defined in this AD, providing a list of known affected parts, and instructions for in -shop modification . For the reason described above, this AD re quires replacement of affected part with a serviceable part, and prohibits (re)installation of affected parts. After the publication of the Proposal to issue this AD, it has been determined that additional A330 models, not included in the applicability of the PAD, are affected. Additional consultation has not been considered in the interest of affected operators.
observed_events_or_defects: An occurrence has been reported where cracks were found in the fuel control unit housing assembly of a Honeywell GTCP331-350 APU, which caused fuel leakage in the APU compartment.
causes: Cracking in the Honeywell GTCP331-350 APU fuel-control-unit housing assembly.
unsafe_conditions: Cracked fuel-control-unit housing can leak fuel into the APU compartment.
affected_components: Honeywell GTCP331-350[C] APU fuel control unit housing assembly
intended_risk_mitigation: Replace the affected fuel-control unit or affected APU with a serviceable unit and prohibit later installation of affected units.

requirements.action_text: (1) For Group 1 aeroplanes, within 36 months after the effective date of this AD, replace the affected APU fuel-control unit with a serviceable part. The applicable Airbus AMM is an acceptable method.

compliance_rules.raw_text: (1) For Group 1 aeroplanes, within 36 months after the effective date of this AD, replace the affected APU fuel-control unit with a serviceable part. The applicable Airbus AMM is an acceptable method.

requirements.action_text: (3.1) For Group 1 aeroplanes, after completing the replacement required by paragraph (1), or the accepted APU-replacement alternative in paragraph (2), do not install an affected part or affected APU.
objects_or_components: Affected APU fuel control unit or affected APU
conditions: After completion of REQ-001 or accepted APU replacement

compliance_rules.raw_text: (3.1) For Group 1 aeroplanes, after completing the replacement required by paragraph (1), or the accepted APU-replacement alternative in paragraph (2), do not install an affected part or affected APU.

initial_limits.reference_event: completion of REQ-001 or accepted alternative

requirements.action_text: (3.2) For Group 2 aeroplanes, from the effective date of this AD, do not install an affected part or affected APU.
objects_or_components: Affected APU fuel control unit or affected APU

compliance_rules.raw_text: (3.2) For Group 2 aeroplanes, from the effective date of this AD, do not install an affected part or affected APU.

initial_limits.raw_value: From the effective date of this AD

exceptions.text: Replacing an affected APU with a serviceable APU is an acceptable alternative method to comply with REQ-001.

EASA AD No.: 2023-0057 which received an epoxy-type repair, as identified by code P30148, P30149, P30150, or P31178 marked on the nameplate. Serviceable part: Any APU fuel control unit, eligible for installation, which is not an affected part. An APU fuel control unit which is re-identified with the SB number (331 -49-7954) on its identification plate is a serviceable part. Affected APU: Honeywell GTCP331-350[C] APUs that have an affected part installed. Serviceable APU: Any Honeywell GTCP331-350[C] APU which is not an affected APU. The SB provides instructions to modify an affected APU into a serviceable APU. Groups: Group 1 aeroplanes are those that have an affected part installed. Group 2 aeroplanes are those that do not have an affected part installed.

Reason: An occurrence has been reported where cracks were found in the fuel control unit housing assembly of a Honeywell GTCP331-350 APU, which caused fuel leakage in the APU compartment. This condition, if not corrected, could lead to an uncommanded APU in-flight shutdown, or fire in the APU compartment, possibly resulting in damage to the aeroplane . To address this potential unsafe condition, Honeywell issued the SB, as defined in this AD, providing a list of known affected parts, and instructions for in -shop modification . For the reason described above, this AD re quires replacement of affected part with a serviceable part, and prohibits (re)installation of affected parts. After the publication of the Proposal to issue this AD, it has been determined that additional A330 models, not included in the applicability of the PAD, are affected. Additional consultation has not been considered in the interest of affected operators.
Ref. Publications: Honeywell SB GTCP331-49-7954 original issue dated 19 December 2007.

Required Action(s) and Compliance Time(s): Required as indicated, unless accomplished previously: Modification: (1) For Group 1 aeroplanes: Within 36 months after the effective date of this AD, replace the affected part with a serviceable part . This can be accomplished in accordance with the instruction of the applicable Airbus aircraft maintenance manual (AMM). (2) Replacement of an affected APU with a serviceable APU on an aeroplane is an acceptable method to comply with the requirements of paragraph (1) of this AD for that aeroplane. This can be accomplished in accordance with the instruction of the applicable Airbus AMM. TE.CAP.00110-011 © European Union Aviation Safety Agency. All rights reserved. ISO9001 Certified.
